g.text: SECOND BRAIN — LANGGRAPH CORRECTIVE RAG (CRAG) WORKFLOW
Comprehensive Graph Architecture: Multi-Domain Routing, Federated Hybrid Search, FlashRank, XML Relevance Grading & Epistemic Synthesis
AgentState = { messages, original_query, domain_filter, target_domains, domain_queries, retrieved_chunks, reranked_chunks, graded_chunks, citations, steps }
Target single partition (eng / econ / law / gen), 1 sub-query
User UI filter override (mode="explicit") restricts target domain(s)
• Direct conversational greeting / meta capability answer
Dense (1024-d FP16, CUDA) + Sparse (BgeM3 / BM25 token weights)
Payload Filters: authority_tier <= max_tier | only_current=True | doc_ids filter
• Parallel asyncio.gather queries across target domain partitions in Qdrant
• Injects "general" fallback sub-query (0.5x RRF discount) if not present
• Calibrated RRF: Score = Σ (dom_weight / (k + rank)) + (1.0/k if entity_match)
• Strictly filters to chosen domains; strips general fallback unless requested
Pool Trimming: Selects top_n = 6 highest scored candidates
• Context Window Expansion: Replaces child_text with token-expanded parent_content
• Provenance Tracking: Preserves source_filename, heading_path, page_numbers
• Epistemic Metadata: Carries domain, subdomain, authority_tier, effective_year
• Output State: reranked_chunks (length <= 6) with normalized relevance scores
Drops any candidate with score < score_threshold (default 0.0)
XML Sanitization: Neutralizes rogue embedded tags into <documents> XML structure
• Robust Index Resolution: Maps 1-based indices (0-based fallback) back to chunks
• Zero Hallucination Gate: Rejects chunks lacking factual evidence for user query
Generates [1]..[N] citations referencing doc, page, heading
Guardrail: validate_and_sanitize_citations() strips hallucinated out-of-range markers
_SYNTHESIZE_SYSTEM_PROMPT: Direct evidence synthesis with strict inline [k] citations
[Mode 6B] Epistemic Triad Multi-Domain Synthesis (>= 2 specialized domains):
Enforces 4-Section Report: ⚙️ Engineering | 📈 Economic | ⚖️ Legal | 🔀 Conflict Matrix
Language Adaptive: Detects Vietnamese / English; isolates physical vs cost vs legal rules
State preservation: AIMessage.additional_kwargs["citations"] persisted to SQLite
• Triggered when zero retrieved documents contain factual evidence for query
• Output: "I could not find sufficient relevant evidence in the indexed knowledge base..."
• Uniform Citation Invariant: returns citations: [] (keeps UI drawer stable)
Indexed Payloads: domain, subdomain, authority_tier, is_current
Thread Invariants: citations, steps, routing metadata preserved
